Based on thorough investigation of the codebase, here are the findings and constraints.

**Findings:**
The codebase has a clear problem: `QueuePanel.axaml` (284 lines, close to the 300-line guard) has no design-time `DataContext`, causing the Avalonia previewer to render garbage — all mutually-exclusive panels (init state, config-diagnostic box, HF-gate footer, status strip) render simultaneously because bindings fail silently. `MainWindow.axaml` does have a `Design.DataContext` but it constructs a bare `MainWindowViewModel` with an empty `Tasks` collection, yielding an empty preview. The fix requires: (1) a `DesignData.cs` static class with pre-populated view models, (2) extracting the ~82-line card `DataTemplate` body into `TaskCard.axaml`, (3) extracting the ~83-line footer into `QueueFooter.axaml`, (4) wiring `Design.*` attributes on all affected files, (5) updating `ContrastTests` to scan all three panel XAML files, and (6) updating `StatusFooterFlyoutTests` to resolve `QueueFooter` first. Key design decisions verified: `RecordStageCompleted` is `internal` (same-assembly access works), `ShowHfGate` depends on `_keyStatesLoaded` which is `false` at design time so the status strip shows, `OnSelectedTaskChanged` fires disk I/O (so `SelectedTask` must remain `null` in design data), and the thin code-behind idiom matches `CommandsView.axaml.cs`. The `TaskCardRenderTests` visual-tree walks (finding `QueuePanel` → `ListBox` → `ListBoxItem` → `Border.queueCard`) will continue to work because extraction preserves the visual ancestry — `TaskCard` is just a `UserControl` wrapping the same `Grid`. `TaskCardThemeGuardTests` scans for `x:Name="TaskQueueList"` alongside `ItemContainerTheme` on the same line, which stays in `QueuePanel.axaml`. The `HeadlessCollectionFiles_HaveCollectionAttribute` test in `SplitGuardVerificationTests.Conventions.cs` has a hardcoded list of 7 files that must NOT be updated for the new `QueuePanelSplitRenderTests.cs`.

**Constraints:**
- Every touched or created `.cs`/`.axaml` file must stay ≤ 300 lines (FileSizeGuard threshold)
- No new NuGet packages or external dependencies of any kind
- Moved XAML must be byte-identical to the original except for stripped `Grid.Row="2"` attributes and new UserControl roots — no attribute reordering, re-indentation, or color/spacing changes
- Use Avalonia's `Design.*` attached properties (`Design.DataContext`, `Design.Width`, `Design.Height`, `Design.PreviewWith`), NOT the Blend `xmlns:d`/`mc:Ignorable` namespace pair
- Do NOT set `Main.SelectedTask` in `DesignData` (it triggers `SelectTaskAsync` which reads markdown from disk)
- Do NOT extract the "Initialize this project" card (`InitEmptyState`) or config-diagnostic box (`HasConfigDiagnostic`) — they're small and tests locate their named controls in QueuePanel's namescope
- Do NOT rename any `x:Name`d control (`TaskQueueList`, `StatusExpandButton`, `InitEmptyState`, `InitTestCommandBox`, `CreateConfigButton`)
- Do NOT touch drag-reorder logic in `QueuePanel.axaml.cs`
- Do NOT split the `DayHeader` block out of `TaskCard`
- Do NOT add `QueuePanelSplitRenderTests.cs` or `DesignDataTests.cs` to the fixed file list in `SplitGuardVerificationTests.Conventions.cs`'s `HeadlessCollectionFiles_HaveCollectionAttribute` test
- `TaskCard` root must NOT set `Background` (keeps transparency chain for `TaskCardRenderTests`)
- `ListBox` line in `QueuePanel.axaml` must keep both `x:Name="TaskQueueList"` and `ItemContainerTheme` on one line (for `TaskCardThemeGuardTests`)
- New `QueuePanelSplitRenderTests` must use `[Collection("Headless")]` and host controls in bare `Window` with `window.Show()` + `Dispatcher.UIThread.RunJobs()` (per scoped-control rule), NOT boot `MainWindow`
- `DesignDataTests.cs` uses plain `[Fact]` (no Avalonia session) — pure view-model assertions
- If a fact-count ratchet test guards a touched test class, bump the ratchet to match — never remove coverage

The card DataTemplate (~82 lines) and two footer Borders (~83 lines) occupy most of QueuePanel.axaml's bulk, leaving ~125 lines after extraction.
